summary: Well-structured test suite covering all core functionality (manifest parsing, license lookup, classification, reporting, formatting) with good separation between unit tests, workflow structure validation, and e2e ActHarness tests. Main gaps: no explicit test for FailOnDenied exit-code behavior, missing tests for malformed manifests and edge cases like empty files or permission errors. ActHarness provides solid e2e confidence with 3 diverse test cases and fixture files that must exist but weren't provided in the listing. Test design is excellent—clear organization, proper fixture isolation, good mocking strategy, and deterministic offline execution. Would catch most regressions, though some error paths lack coverage.
